name: Zidane hair gate
about: Run: gaw gate --spec skills/gaw/references/zidane-hair-gate.json --out-dir NEW_DIR CANDIDATE.glb (from the Modding folder). Stock passes against itself; every rule is relative to stock, so a version is judged against what the game already shows.

rules.why: straight cuts across the strand flow where cards meet
same, as a share of the card edges
fine wood-grain stripes where stock has broad locks

rules.id: no new cut, smear or flat box at marks 1 6 7 8 9
rules.why: the user's marks: a hit means more boxes of these kinds than stock has in the same circle

rules.id: no new speck box at marks 2 3 4 5 8
rules.why: dots, dither and cut-off shards at the user's marks
